critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1981 lines (up from 1907 last iter, from 1389 at iter 1). The sponsor inquiry model + handler + admin route and pitch public-stats handler keep accumulating in the same file. The 'split into routers/ + services/' advice from iterations 1-3 is now 4 features overdue.

SponsorInquiry email validation is a manual string check ('@' + '.' in TLD segment). FastAPI/Pydantic EmailStr would catch more edge cases (e.g. 'a@.com', 'a@@b.c', unicode). Low-risk for a public lead-capture form, but worth switching to EmailStr for consistency.
POST /api/sponsor/inquire has no rate limiting visible. Public unauthenticated write endpoint is a spam/abuse vector — recommend simple per-IP throttle (e.g. 5/min) or a honeypot field before launch.
sponsor_inquiries documents store source_ip + user_agent but no TTL index. GDPR/CCPA minimization suggests either masking the IP (as ip_hash is done for pitch_upvotes) or adding a retention window.
Public /api/pitch/public-stats computes aggregates with find(..).to_list(500) then sums in Python. Fine at current scale but a Mongo $facet aggregation pipeline would scale better past ~10k pitches.
/api/admin/sponsor/inquiries has no pagination (to_list(1000) hardcoded). Will silently truncate past 1000 inquiries — fine for Phase 1, flag for later.
